description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordDecorator class, a decorator or wrapper around the AttendanceRecord entity that adds methods for formatting and computing date/time-related attributes and labels for attendance records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing advanced formatting and time zone conversion methods for AttendanceRecord entity instances, facilitating display and manipulation of attendance data.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the attendance record based on the employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceState
methods.description: Returns the attendance state in title case.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC date formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC time formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user’s punch-in date formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user’s punch-in time formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC date formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCtime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC time formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user’s punch-out date formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user’s punch-out time formatted as string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user DateTime object, computing if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC DateTime object, computing if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user DateTime object, computing if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC DateTime object, computing if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns a label representing the punch-in timezone offset and name.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns a label representing the punch-out timezone offset and name.
